verses.english: “Just as, mendicants, even a little bit of fecal matter still stinks,

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, appamattakampi bhavaṁ na vaṇṇemi, antamaso accharāsaṅghātamattampi”.
verses.english: so too I don’t approve of even a little bit of continued existence, not even as long as a finger-snap.”
